chip_role.label: Audio CPU
chip_role.description: A CPU dedicated to running the sound driver and controlling sound chips, kept separate from game logic even when the part itself is a general-purpose CPU.

chip_role.label: CRT controller
chip_role.description: Generates raster timing only — sync, blanking, display address counters — with no pixel content of its own; contrast with sprite/tilemap, which produce pixels.

chip_role.label: DMA
chip_role.description: A bus-mastering transfer engine moving blocks between memory and devices on this board, freeing the CPU from per-word transfers.

chip_role.label: DSP / coprocessor
chip_role.description: A math or signal coprocessor assisting the main CPU with a specific computation (matrix transforms, compression, geometry), not running the game program itself.

chip_role.label: Glue logic
chip_role.description: Catalog logic with no system-level identity on this board: 74-series parts, PAL/GAL decoders, buffers, clock generators.

chip_role.label: I/O
chip_role.description: Handles controller inputs, DIP switches, coin/service lines or other system I/O; not sound- or video-specific.

chip_role.label: Main CPU
chip_role.description: The primary CPU driving game logic; the sole CPU on single-CPU boards.

chip_role.label: Microcontroller
chip_role.description: A microcontroller performing a bounded task — protection, I/O scanning, a small subsystem — rather than running the main game program.

chip_role.label: Memory
chip_role.description: Governs memory mapping or bank switching on this board (MMU, mapper); not a storage medium itself.

chip_role.label: Mixer / palette
chip_role.description: Combines already-generated video layers into the final picture: priority resolution, palette lookup, blending.

chip_role.label: Protection
chip_role.description: The board-level copy-protection or region-lockout part, regardless of what its die-level function otherwise is.

chip_role.label: Real-time clock
chip_role.description: A battery-backed clock/calendar chip tracking wall-clock time across power-off.

chip_role.label: Sound
chip_role.description: A sound-generating chip (FM, PSG, sample playback, etc.) driven by audiocpu or maincpu; use a more specific role for the CPU that drives it, not this one.

chip_role.label: Sprite
chip_role.description: Fetches, positions, sizes and line-buffers movable objects; contrast with tilemap, which draws the scrolling background.

chip_role.label: Storage
chip_role.description: Controls a mass-storage medium attached to this board: floppy, hard disk, CD/GD-ROM.

chip_role.label: Sub CPU
chip_role.description: A second general-purpose CPU sharing game-logic duties with maincpu (e.g. dual-CPU boards), distinct from a CPU dedicated to sound.

chip_role.label: Tilemap
chip_role.description: Generates scrolling tile or character background layers, including affine rotate/zoom layers.

chip_role.label: Timer
chip_role.description: Supplies interval timing or periodic interrupts to the rest of the board.

chip_role.label: Unspecified
chip_role.description: The chip's presence on the board is known but its role has not yet been curated — a placeholder, not a claim that it has no role.

chip_role.label: Video
chip_role.description: A video chip whose job does not fit a more specific role below; prefer sprite/tilemap/mixer/crtc when the part is dedicated to one of those jobs.
